# Feed Posting

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](gmeow-FeedPosting.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/FeedPosting>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A short-form work published to a feed, timeline, or platform — a social-media post, a blog entry, a microblog note. A specialisation of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md); its kind (social / blog / microblog) is an open [`gmeow:FeedPostingKind`](gmeow-FeedPostingKind.md) value, never a subclass. Carries the work metadata (title, author, [`datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md)) and may quote ([`gmeow:quotesContent`](../properties/gmeow-quotesContent.md)) or share ([`gmeow:sharesContent`](../properties/gmeow-sharesContent.md)) other content.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](gmeow-FeedPosting.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a short-form syndicated work published to a feed, timeline, or platform — a social post, microblog note, or blog entry that may quote or repost other content.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the posting flavour as a subclass (the kind is a [`gmeow:feedPostingKind`](../properties/gmeow-feedPostingKind.md) value, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and avoid it for a long-form scholarly piece (use [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md)).

### How to use

- Type the post [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](gmeow-FeedPosting.md), set its flavour with [`gmeow:feedPostingKind`](../properties/gmeow-feedPostingKind.md), carry [`datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md) and title; record quotation via [`gmeow:quotesContent`](../properties/gmeow-quotesContent.md) / [`gmeow:quotedText`](../properties/gmeow-quotedText.md) and a repost via [`gmeow:sharesContent`](../properties/gmeow-sharesContent.md). Postings project to [schema:SocialMediaPosting](https://schema.org/SocialMediaPosting) / BlogPosting and [sioc:Post.](http://rdfs.org/sioc/ns#Post.)
